data.long_meaning: From the French word 'reneller', meaning 'to rejuvenate'. In the context of baby names, Renelle could be interpreted as 'reborn one' or 'little reborn'. The name Renelle carries the meaning “Reborn, little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Renelle usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Renelle can carry deep meanings and symbolism.
